overview.history: Piano Sonata no. 16 — Movement 1 is ready to explore on Lune. It is associated with Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart. Stylistically it sits in the Classical world. Start by listening, then ask about the bars that surprise your hands. Sonatas are journeys: notice how the opening idea returns changed.

eraInfo.label: Classical
eraInfo.story: Clarity, elegant proportions, and conversation between phrases. Themes are easy to follow — then they get playfully changed and returned.
tips: Save big drama for true climaxes.

composerInfo.name: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart
composerInfo.hook: Mozart makes elegance sound easy — every phrase is a clear conversation.
composerInfo.bio: He completed more than 800 works in his life—including outstanding examples of most of the genres of his time: symphonies, concertos, chamber music, opera and choral music—and is regarded as one of the greatest composers in the history of Western music.
